name: Ancient Root Ogre
loreTies: A massive root-fed guardian of wounded woods; it is not evil, but it crushes intruders who ignore Avalora’s living terrain.
Blocks chokepoints and creates destructible terrain pressure.
source culture humans later copied as Celtic and Irish fae myth
shortBackstory: Ancient Root Ogre is a lore-faithful Tuatha run-in creature used when missions or events justify faction contact without rewriting the faction or creating playable squads.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Ancient Root Ogre belongs to Avalora and exists to express Tuatha law, pressure, or defense during Gate instability.

chapters.title: Faction Function
chapters.text: Blocks chokepoints and creates destructible terrain pressure.

chapters.title: Lore Guardrail
chapters.text: Do not use as a generic monster; keep faction law, materials, motives, and silhouette intact.

chapters.title: Campaign Use
chapters.text: It may appear in enemy-controlled zones, border conflicts, Gate events, pursuits, trials, bargains, or defensive reactions when the mission gives a lore-valid reason.

chapters.title: Visual / Encounter Rule
chapters.text: Visuals must follow: Huge moss-root body, stone teeth, moon fungus shoulders, braided vine muscles. Abilities — Root Slam, Living Wall, Spore Stagger — must telegraph clearly for mobile one-Deity-vs-many combat.

developmentStatus: Readable faction run-in creature profile integrated into mission/event encounter pools.
